learning_outcomes.text: Acquires knowledge about semiconductor power elements.
Performs power, total harmonic distortion, and power factor calculations in non-sinusoidal circuits.

syllabus_topics: AC-DC converters: Single-phase half-wave uncontrolled and controlled rectifiers
AC-DC converters: Single-phase full-wave uncontrolled and controlled rectifiers
AC-DC converters: Three-phase uncontrolled and controlled rectifiers
DC-DC converters: Buck DC-DC converter - Discontinuous Conduction Mode
DC-AC converters: Single-phase full-wave PWM inverter
assessment_rules: The assessment methods vary, with some groups having a midterm (40%) and final (60%), and others having a quiz (15%), midterm (35%), and final (50%). Midterm and final exam dates are determined by the university's academic calendar.
bibliography: D. W. Hart, Introduction to Power Electronics, Prentice Hall, 1997.
Erickson, R.W., Fundamentals of Power Electronics, Chapman and Hall, New York
Güç Elektroniği (Yarıiletken Elemanlar, Devreler ve Uygulamaları), Muhammed M. Rashid, Nobel Yayınevi
N. Tuncay, M. Gökaşan, S. Boğosyan, Güç Elektroniği: Çeviriciler, Uygulamalar Ve Tasarım, Literatür Yayıncılık, 2007.
institution: Düzce University — Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği (Electrical-Electronics Engineering), Normal Öğretim
